# drawbridge — social media domains
#
# Curated and pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json, unlike the large upstream
# lists which rotate daily. Entries cover the parent domain only; matching is
# suffix-based, so `facebook.com` also blocks `m.facebook.com`.
#
# YouTube is deliberately absent: it is handled by safe-search / restricted-mode
# rewriting at the DNS layer rather than blocked outright.

# Meta
facebook.com
fb.com
fb.me

threads.net
threads.com
